messages:
Alex: Heads-up — quick design sync on multi-y charts. I'm prototyping a small 'Scale guide' that appears when you hover the axis header. It maps series -> axis and shows unit. Preview: https://preview/redwood/multi-y-proto.png
Rachael: Love the guide idea. Two asks: keyboard accessible (focusable, closes on Esc) and microcopy needs to be concise. Example: 'Left axis: latency (ms)' not the whole p50/p95 list in the header.
Sam: For the legend, instead of relying on colour alone can we add a tiny axis indicator (L / R) next to the chip? Keeps it compact but disambiguates. Fallback when space is tight: show 'L/R' instead of full unit.
Priya: Copy preference: use 'Latency (ms)' and 'Throughput (req/s)'. Avoid internal acronyms like 'rps' in product UI. For per-second units, we can put 'req/s' visible and '1/s' as secondary tooltip hint.
Alex: Good call. Also thinking about smoothing controls — should we expose numeric window (e.g., 5-pt, 25-pt) or percentages? Numeric seems clearer for time-series. Example label: 'Smoothing window: 5 points (preserve spikes)'.
Rachael: Numeric too. Keep microcopy under 50 chars. Suggest: 'Smoothing — 5-point (light) / 25-point (strong)'. Small help icon opens detailed explainer.
Sam: Outlier handling options: propose two modes: dim (context-preserving) vs suppress (remove from chart). I prefer dimming for dashboards so users see context. Dimming level should be subtle (~40% opacity). Also add an export toggle to 'suppress outliers' so CSVs don't get skewed.
Priya: Accessibility note: if we dim lines, ensure contrast still meets WCAG when combined with colorblind palettes. Maybe add a hatch/pattern on hover to indicate outlier instead of only opacity — though that could clutter dense charts.
Rachael: Screen reader flow: legend items should expose aria labels like 'Series name, axis left, unit milliseconds, visible'. Focus order should be: legend -> chart -> tooltip. Tooltip must be reachable via keyboard and dismissed with Esc.
Priya: Example aria snippet:
```
aria-label="Latency — left axis — unit: milliseconds — visible"
role="button"
```
That maps nicely to the SR announcement when focusing legend items.
DesignBot: Prototype screenshot uploaded: https://assets.preview/redwood/multiy-2034567890.png :thumbsup:
Alex: Next steps — Rachael to draft 3 copy variants (concise, explanatory, example-driven), Sam to mock the compact legend with L/R chips + overflow behavior, Priya to draft aria strings and a short a11y checklist. Reconvene Wed 10am. Thanks!
